class.name: VisionOSMarkerTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a reference image, such as a printed QR code, found by ARKit.
class.description: Represents an ARKit image anchor for an image registered with [method VisionOSXRInterface.add_marker_reference_image]. Trackers are named [code]visionos/marker/<uuid>[/code] and added to the [XRServer] when ARKit first finds the image. The [code]default[/code] pose follows the OpenXR spatial marker convention: the origin is the image center, +X points to the image's right, +Y towards its top edge, and +Z out of the printed face. While [member marker_tracked] is [code]false[/code] the last pose is kept with [constant XRPose.XR_TRACKING_CONFIDENCE_LOW].

members.member: The registered physical size in meters, multiplied by [member estimated_scale_factor].
ARKit's estimate of the printed size relative to the registered physical size.
The name the reference image was registered with.
If [code]true[/code], ARKit currently sees the image and the pose is current.
The UUID ARKit assigned to this image anchor.
The physical size in meters the reference image was registered with.

signal.name: tracking_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ARKit starts or stops seeing the image.
